trade_name_line: WageTheft.law is operated by Centurion Trial Attorneys, APC, which also operates SueMyBoss.Law.
description: California wage theft lawyers. Unpaid overtime, missed meal and rest breaks, off-the-clock work, late final paychecks, misclassification and PAGA claims, for one worker or a whole crew. Free case review.
knows_about: Final paycheck and waiting time penalties

claims.title: Unpaid overtime
claims.text: In California, most hourly workers earn overtime after 8 hours in a day or 40 in a week, not just after 40.

claims.title: Missed meal and rest breaks
claims.text: Each workday your employer denies a required break can owe you an extra hour of pay.

claims.title: Working off the clock
claims.text: Security checks, pre-shift meetings, answering texts after hours: time you work is time you're owed.

claims.title: A late final paycheck
claims.text: Fired? Your final pay is due right away. When it's late, penalties can add up to 30 days of wages.

claims.title: Called a contractor, treated like an employee
claims.text: California's ABC test presumes you're an employee. Misclassified workers can be owed overtime, breaks and expenses.

claims.title: PAGA, explained
claims.text: California's Private Attorneys General Act lets a worker recover penalties for Labor Code violations that hit coworkers too.
